title: trifolium fucatum f. flavulum
intro: Trifolium fucatum f. flavulum, commonly known as the yellow-flowered red clover, is a subspecies of the red clover plant (Trifolium fucatum). It is a legume native to the temperate regions of Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. Trifolium fucatum f. flavulum has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, supporting the alleviation of menopausal symptoms and the improvement of cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, particularly formononetin and genistein, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including estrogenic and anti-cancer properties.
